subject: science
title: Grade 5 Science — Set 2
description: Solar system, body systems, cells, and water cycle

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun. The order from Sun: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars...

questions.question: What is the main function of the heart?
questions.explanation: The heart is a pump that circulates blood throughout the body, delivering oxygen and nutrients.

questions.question: At what temperature does water boil?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C (212°F) at sea level. Above this temperature it becomes steam.

questions.question: Which part of the plant carries out photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll and carry out photosynthesis to make food for the plant.

questions.question: What is the basic unit of life?
questions.explanation: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of all living organisms.
